🎬 Average Joe (2024)

Average Joe follows Joe Kennedy, a high school football coach in Bremerton, Washington, whose life changes dramatically when his decision to pray on the football field after games sparks a nationwide controversy over religious freedom and personal beliefs. A former Marine who finds purpose in mentoring young athletes, Joe believes that faith, discipline, and perseverance are important parts of his life. However, when school officials raise concerns about his public prayers, he becomes involved in a growing dispute that threatens his coaching career and places enormous pressure on his family. As the disagreement attracts national attention, Joe faces difficult choices involving his personal convictions, professional responsibilities, and relationships with the people closest to him. From emotional family struggles and tense confrontations to legal battles and unexpected setbacks, his journey becomes a test of determination and resilience. With support from his wife and legal team, Joe continues fighting for what he believes is his constitutional right, eventually taking his case to the United States Supreme Court. Based on true events, the film combines emotional drama, inspirational storytelling, and courtroom conflict while exploring faith, freedom of expression, courage, sacrifice, and the challenges of standing by one’s convictions.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Biography • Faith-Based

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Harold Cronk
